requirements:
frozendict
conda-build
conda
conda-smithy
boa
requests
conda-index
PyGithub
networkx
ruamel.yaml
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes all detected imports with standard PyPI package names (conda_build→conda-build, github→PyGithub, yaml→ruamel.yaml). The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs requirements, copies code, and sets a default python command for execution.
